purpose: Record the strengthened Graph-PHP Hall/matching result as backfilled foundational authority without rewriting later TRUMP chronology.

foundational_authority.exact_semantics: SAT iff the recognized bipartite graph has a matching saturating L; UNSAT iff there exists S subset L with |N(S)|<|S|.

precise_claim: For the theorem-backed recognizable bounded-degree graph-PHP family: constant initial CNF width + Omega(n) required Resolution refutation width + polynomial exact Hall/matching representation.
preferred_interpretation: Hardness in Resolution width does not imply hardness of deciding this family after an admissible exact structural representation change.
forbidden_overstatement: Do not generalize this to hardness or easiness of proof representations in general.
finite_fixture_role: n=16,20,24,32 instances certify the frozen expansion contract only; they are not the source of the asymptotic Omega(n) claim.

literature_authority.resolution_width: Ben-Sasson-Wigderson Theorem 4.15: w(G-PHP |- 0) >= r e / 2 for the stated expander parameters; degree-5 m=n+1 families with r=Theta(n), e=1 give Omega(n).
literature_authority.hall: Hall criterion supplies the exact saturating-matching condition and deficient-set UNSAT witness.
literature_authority.matching_algorithm: Maximum bipartite matching is polynomial-time; Hopcroft-Karp is a standard example.

chronology_policy.future_graph_php_semantics_reference: Prefer this Hall/matching authority over the earlier counting-only formulation.
